{{Quote|The Conservator and his followers drove out all of the archaeologists who were studying these ruins, including the Selkath.|[[Qrukk]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
The '''Ancient Selkath City''' was the ruins of an ancient [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] settlement located in the [[Asutvu Rift]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. Built on the ocean floor, the city was destroyed eons before the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:PH" />

==History==
{{Quote|We have many collectors interested in artifacts from a lost city in the Asutvu Rift. Treasures that we are unable to provide. A cult has firmly embedded themselves in the city's ruins. No one can even approach, let alone enter the site. [...] Fanatical isolationists, led by a zealot who calls himself 'The Conservator.'&thinsp;|[[Shak Los]]|<ref name="TOR:ACP" />}}
[[File:Ancient_Selkath_City_2.jpg|thumb|right|280px|The Ancient Selkath City]]
The city was discovered prior to the Third Galactic War. The Selkath then placed the entire city under a dome and constructed an [[Archaeology Center]] nearby in order to conduct excavation of the city.<ref name="TOR:AA">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=faction|Imperial|Amateur Archeology|Manaan}}</ref>

The Ancient Selkath City was taken over by the Selkath isolationists of the [[Syphus Collective]] during the Third Galactic War. The area saw intense fighting during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR:PH" />
